historical_record.description: The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and allowed the permit to paint a sign on 2415 Van Ness to stand, with a condition.
Holy Trinity Cathedral was at 2415 Van Ness.
The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to paint a sign at 2415 Van Ness Avenue.

The Board of Permit Appeals upheld the Department of Public Works and denied the permit for a painted wall sign at 2415 Van Ness Avenue, the three votes to overrule falling short of the four required.
